title: Activate 3EN Agent Runner v3.6 safely
description: Controlled switchover from active v3.5 to staged v3.6. The task creates and launches a delayed helper. v3.5 is allowed to finish and persist this successful task first. The helper then starts v3.6, verifies a v3.6 process exists, and only then stops the previously captured v3.5 process. If v3.6 does not start, v3.5 is left running. No file replacement is performed.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $src='C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1'; $dst='C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1'; if(-not(Test-Path $src)){throw 'v3.5 missing'}; if(-not(Test-Path $dst)){throw 'v3.6 missing'}; $h5=(Get-FileHash $src -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; $h6=(Get-FileHash $dst -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $b=Join-Path 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\020a' $stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $b|Out-Null; Copy-Item $src (Join-Path $b '3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1') -Force; Copy-Item $dst (Join-Path $b '3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1') -Force; Set-Content 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-020a-current.txt' $b; Write-Host ('V35_SHA256='+$h5); Write-Host ('V36_SHA256='+$h6); Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$b); Write-Host 'BACKUP_020A_READY'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $helper='C:\3EN-Agent\switch-to-v36-020a.ps1'; $old=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1*' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessId); if(@($old).Count -eq 0){throw 'Active v3.5 process not found'}; $oldCsv=($old -join ','); $lines=[string[]]@('$ErrorActionPreference=''Continue''',('$oldPids=@('+$oldCsv+')'),'Start-Sleep -Seconds 8','$v36=''C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1''','$p=Start-Process -FilePath ''powershell.exe'' -ArgumentList @(''-NoProfile'',''-ExecutionPolicy'',''Bypass'',''-File'',$v36) -PassThru','Start-Sleep -Seconds 5','$new=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like ''*3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1*'' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessId)','if(@($new).Count -gt 0){ foreach($pidOld in $oldPids){ Stop-Process -Id $pidOld -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Add-Content ''C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent.log'' (''SWITCH_020A=PASS V36_PIDS=''+($new -join '','')) } else { Add-Content ''C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent.log'' ''SWITCH_020A=FAIL V35_LEFT_RUNNING'' }'); Set-Content -LiteralPath $helper -Value $lines -Encoding UTF8; Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$helper) | Out-Null; Write-Host ('OLD_V35_PIDS='+$oldCsv); Write-Host ('HELPER='+$helper); Write-Host 'SWITCH_HELPER_SCHEDULED=TRUE'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $helper='C:\3EN-Agent\switch-to-v36-020a.ps1'; if(-not(Test-Path $helper)){throw 'Switch helper missing'}; $tok=$null;$err=$null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($helper,[ref]$tok,[ref]$err)|Out-Null; if(@($err).Count -gt 0){throw ('Helper syntax errors='+@($err).Count)}; Write-Host 'HELPER_SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT=0'; Write-Host 'CONTROLLED_SWITCH_020A=ARMED'; Write-Host 'NOTE=helper waits 8 seconds before starting v3.6, then verifies v3.6 before stopping v3.5'
rollback: Write-Host 'ROLLBACK_020A: if helper has not switched yet, close helper process manually; if v3.6 is active and rollback is required, start C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1 and stop v3.6. Both files and verified backups remain intact.'
